name: Oraxen Item Definition
description: Configuration schema for Oraxen custom items and pack mechanics

sections.title: Resource Pack & Models
sections.description: Defines custom texture paths and JSON model linking for Oraxen pack compilation

fields.label: Auto-generate Model
fields.description: Whether Oraxen should auto-generate the item JSON model

fields.label: Model Path
fields.description: Relative path to the resource pack model (without .json)

sections.title: Item Mechanics
sections.description: Special behaviors handled by Oraxen engine

fields.label: Custom Durability
fields.description: Custom hit/use points before item breaks

fields.label: Furniture Item
fields.description: Whether right-clicking places a 3D furniture entity display

default_yaml_template:
Pack:
  generate_model: true
  model: custom/weapons/example
  parent_model: item/handheld
Mechanics:
  custom_durability: 1000
  furniture: false
